dct_description_sm: The files contain data from two studies (multipopulation and single population) of unreduced gamete production in Chamerion angustifolium. Results, based on 2x X 4x crosses, provide estimates of unreduced sperm and eggs at two elevation zones.
dct_title_s: Data for: Gamete sex and elevation affect genetically based variation for unreduced gamete production in a mixed-ploidy plant
